parameters.content:
## 08-17-01 automate short term rental guest messages and cleaning tasks

### How it works

New bookings arrive on a webhook, are validated and logged to the Bookings sheet. A daily sweep finds stays that are due: check-in tomorrow, check-out today or a review request two days after check-out. An AI agent reads the property playbook and drafts a warm personalized message for each guest, Gmail sends it and the GuestLog sheet records it. On check-out day the sweep also creates a cleaning task and emails the cleaner. Every Monday the host gets a digest with occupancy, upcoming stays, pending cleaning tasks and an AI written summary.

### Setup steps

- Create a Google Sheet with four tabs: Bookings, GuestLog, CleaningTasks and Playbook
- Connect Google Sheets, Gmail, Telegram and OpenAI credentials in the nodes
- Point the booking source (Airbnb, Booking.com or a form) at the booking intake webhook
- Fill the Playbook tab with one row per property so the AI uses real details
- Add the cleaner email in each booking row so check-out creates the cleaning task

### Customization

- Change the sweep cron or run it on demand with the manual sweep webhook
- Add message types such as a mid-stay check-in in Compute Due Actions
- Swap Telegram for Slack or Discord for host alerts

## Booking intake

A webhook receives new bookings, validates the required fields and logs them to the Bookings sheet. Invalid bookings alert the host on Telegram and by email.

nodes.name: Sticky Note: Daily guest message sweep

parameters.content:
## Daily guest message sweep

Every morning the sweep finds check-in, check-out and review-request bookings. The AI drafts a message from the playbook, Gmail sends it and every message is logged.

## Cleaning task operations

On check-out day a cleaning task is created, the cleaner gets an email and the host gets a Telegram alert when no cleaner is assigned.

## Weekly host digest

Every Monday the host gets a digest with occupancy, upcoming stays, pending cleaning tasks and an AI written summary, by email and Telegram.
